header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Exercise Patience on the Occasions of Death

Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) and Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) Exercise Patience upon the Demise of their Son

Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that (his mother) Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) once came to his father Abu Anas saying, "Today I have come with news that you will dislike." His response was: "You are always coming with news from that Bedouin that I dislike." She said, "He is a Bedouin whom Allaah has selected and made a Nabi." "What is the news you have brought?" he asked. "Wine has been forbidden," she replied. To this he said, "Then this is where we separate." He then died as a Mushrik.
When Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) approached Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) (with a marriage proposal), she said, "I cannot marry you when you are a Mushrik." "No," exclaimed Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA), "By Allaah! That is not your motive." "Then what is my motive?" asked Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA). "Your motive is gold and silver," he replied. "In that case," retorted Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA), "I make you and the Nabi of Allaah ﷺ witness to the fact that if you accept Islaam, I shall be content with you giving me only your acceptance of Islaam (as dowry. I want nothing else)." "Who will stand guarantee for me to this agreement?" Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) asked. Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) then said, "O Anas! Get up and go with your uncle."
Hadhrat Anas (RA) got up and with Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA)'s hand on his shoulder, they proceeded. When they got close to where Rasulullaah ﷺ was and he heard their voices, he remarked, "Here is Abu Talha with the radiance of Islaam sparkling between his eyes." Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) greeted Rasulullaah ﷺ and then professed:
"أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ"
I testify that there is none worthy of worship but Allaah and that Muhammad ﷺ is the Rasul of Allaah
Rasulullaah ﷺ then married him (to Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA)) on the condition of his accepting Islaam. Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) later fathered a son who was the apple of his father's eye. However, when the child started to walk, Allaah decided to take the child away.
(Still unaware that the child had passed away) Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) came to Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) asking, "How is my son, O Ummu Sulaym?" "Better then he had been (because death has relieved him of his illness)," she replied. She then said further, "Why don't you have your supper because it is already late."
